assertion: The nationwide stop was the first since January 2023, when a key FAA computer system that sends notices to pilots malfunctioned, and the second since the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks.
independent_value: CBS: first nationwide ground stop since Jan 2023; before that 9/11

assertion: Friday's ground stop lasted more than four hours.
independent_value: CBS: began 3:36 p.m. ET, lifted about 8:20 p.m. ET

assertion: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said a contractor had been replacing a section of the system's old copper wire with new fiber wire, and that work somehow caused the system overload.
speaker: Sean Duffy
independent_value: CNN and CBS quote Duffy on L3Harris copper-to-fiber switch, router flooding, cause (error vs faulty router) undetermined

assertion: Duffy said that 70% of the system had been replaced with fiber optic wire.
speaker: Sean Duffy
independent_value: CNN: around 30% not yet replaced; CBS: about 70% transferred

assertion: Andrew Charlton, an aviation consultant, said Friday's stoppage affected about a quarter of the 45,000 flights in the U.S. each day.
speaker: Andrew Charlton
inaccuracy: FAA's Bedford put Friday's schedule at 50,000 flights with about 12,000 not completed (about a quarter); 45,000 is a rougher figure
warehouse_value: BTS reporting carriers alone average 19,183 flights/day in 2025 (large carriers only, not comparable)

assertion: FlightAware, a website that tracks flights, said more than 4,100 flights had been canceled Saturday. Cirium put that number above 3,200 flights.
inaccuracy: Snapshot count; CNN reported 5,000+ canceled by 1 p.m. ET Saturday, so the article understates the day's total
independent_value: CNN: more than 5,000 canceled Saturday as of 1 p.m. ET per FlightAware

assertion: Duffy reiterated Saturday that no one was in any danger as more than 3,000 flights in the air at the time of the grounding order landed safely.
speaker: Sean Duffy
independent_value: Duffy: 3,500+ planes airborne, all landed safely

assertion: The FAA has replaced thousands of old copper wires with fiber optic lines as part of an overhaul that began last year after Congress approved $12.5 billion in funding. Duffy and the White House are pushing for $30 billion more.
independent_value: CBS: $12.5B approved, request raised to $30B; modernskies.faa.gov returned empty content

assertion: The president has largely been quiet on the topic. He has not spoken publicly on the matter, nor issued statements via social media.
independent_value: True as of Saturday; CBS reports Trump posted on Truth Social Sunday, after publication

assertion: The nation's longest ground stop in 25 years.
independent_value: Consistent with 9/11 as the only longer one; Jan 2023 stop was far shorter; no contrary source found

assertion: The U.S. air travel schedule should be back to normal by the end of Sunday, Bryan Bedford, administrator of the FAA, said.
speaker: Bryan Bedford
independent_value: CNN: Bedford expects full recovery Sunday
